record.question: Which female Asian Athlete figures in top 10 of Forbes highest Earning female athlete in 2018?
record.explanation: Answer C: P.V. Sindhu. Forbes’ original 2018 highest-paid female athletes list includes P.V.Sindhu in seventh place, with estimated earnings of US$8.5 million. Its accounting period was the 12 months ending 1 June 2018 and included prize money, appearances, royalties and endorsements. None of the other printed athletes appears in its top ten. Historical/source note: Forbes’ estimated earnings over its stated 12-month measurement period, rather than 2018 calendar-year prize money alone. Reference: https://tollbit.forbes.com/sites/kurtbadenhausen/2018/08/21/the-highest-paid-female-athletes-2018/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
